{"test_name":"Ledger_2297_Objection1","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection1\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task CompositeResolver_NetStandard13Defined_OmitsExcludeFromCodeCoverageAndCompiles()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n            using MessagePack.Resolvers;\n\n            namespace TempProject\n            {\n                [CompositeResolver(typeof(StandardResolver), typeof(BuiltinResolver))]\n                public partial class MyCompositeResolver\n                {\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references = frameworkRefs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack)).ToImmutableArray();\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest, preprocessorSymbols: new[] { \"NETSTANDARD1_3\" });\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, parseOptions) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(runResult.Results, r => r.Exception is not null);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(output.GetDiagnostics(), d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        ImmutableArray<GeneratedSourceResult> generatedSources = runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources).ToImmutableArray();\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedSources);\n\n        GeneratedSourceResult compositeSource = generatedSources.FirstOrDefault(s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"partial class MyCompositeResolver\"));\n        Assert.NotNull(compositeSource.SyntaxTree);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverSymbol = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TempProject.MyCompositeResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverSymbol);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr);\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(resolverSymbol!.GetAttributes(), a => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(a.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterCacheSymbol = resolverSymbol.GetTypeMembers(\"FormatterCache\").SingleOrDefault();\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterCacheSymbol);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(formatterCacheSymbol!.GetAttributes(), a => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(a.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr));\n    }\n}\n"}
